mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_sync_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND retry_count < max_retries AND next_retry_at <= #{now} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_sync_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

UPDATE sys_sync_task t SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_at = #{now}, locked_by = #{workerId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE t.id IN ( SELECT id FROM sys_sync_task s WHERE s.delete_flag = 0 AND ( (s.status = 'PENDING' AND (s.next_retry_at IS NULL OR s.next_retry_at <= #{now})) OR ( s.status = 'PROCESSING' AND s.locked_at IS NOT NULL AND s.locked_at < ( CASE WHEN s.batch_key_hash IS NOT NULL THEN #{fullSyncStaleBefore} WHEN s.sync_action = 'PERM_ABSTRACT_USER_SYNC' THEN #{abstractUserStaleBefore} WHEN s.sync_action = 'PERM_ABSTRACT_ROLE_SYNC' THEN #{abstractRoleStaleBefore} WHEN s.sync_action = 'PERM_USER_ROLE_SYNC' THEN #{userRoleStaleBefore} WHEN s.sync_action = 'PERM_RESOURCE_ENTITY_SYNC' THEN #{resourceEntityStaleBefore} ELSE #{defaultStaleBefore} END ) ) ) AND ( s.batch_key_hash IS NULL OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_sync_task tf WHERE tf.batch_key_hash = s.batch_key_hash AND tf.status = 'FAILED' AND tf.delete_flag = 0 ) AND s.phase = ( SELECT t2.phase FROM sys_sync_task t2 WHERE t2.batch_key_hash = s.batch_key_hash AND t2.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND t2.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY (CASE t2.phase WHEN 'USER_SUBJECT' THEN 1 WHEN 'USER_RESOURCE' THEN 2 WHEN 'ORG_RESOURCE' THEN 3 WHEN 'ORG_ROLE' THEN 4 WHEN 'USER_ROLE' THEN 5 WHEN 'MENU_RESOURCE' THEN 6 WHEN 'OTHER_RESOURCE' THEN 7 ELSE 99 END) ASC, t2.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) ) ORDER BY s.created_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{batchSize} ) RETURNING *
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_sync_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_by = #{workerId} AND delete_flag = 0
